name: UniFi Network JVM GC Thrash
description: Catches the UniFi Network application on a UniFi OS gateway spending most of its time in Full GC pauses. Routing keeps working while it happens, but the UniFi Console web UI and app stop responding and settings cannot be changed. Restarting the unifi service clears it.
whatItWatches: The share of the last 60 seconds the Network application's JVM spent paused in Full GC, read from /data/unifi/logs/gc.log on the gateway.
whenItFires: 25% or more of the window in Full GC pauses on two consecutive samples, a minute apart. A healthy gateway sits under 1%.
whatItDoes: Alerts, and restarts the unifi service. Either can be switched off below. A gateway with no local Network application (one managed by a self-hosted console) reports not applicable and stays quiet.
command: [ -r /data/unifi/logs/gc.log ] || { echo NA; exit 0; }; tail -n 600 /data/unifi/logs/gc.log | awk 'BEGIN { n = 0 } /^\[/ { t = substr($1, 2) + 0; if (t > last) last = t } /Pause Full/ { ts[n] = t; ps[n] = $NF + 0; n++ } END { w = 60; s = 0; c = 0; for (i = 0; i < n; i++) if (ts[i] >= last - w) { s += ps[i]; c++ }; printf "%.1f %d\n", s / (w * 10), c }'
